verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-definable rules engine or event-to-action automation builder inside Vanta. Webhooks (vanta-docs-4) only deliver event notifications to an external endpoint, so any triggered action has to be built by the consumer; that is a developer building block, not the capability. Custom Tests (vanta-docs-2) produce pass/fail evidence rather than triggering actions, and the generic claims about automated reminders and workflows (vanta-docs-22) are adjacent marketing statements, not configurable rules.
